teal.$description: Warna utama brand — ikon, letter 'E' wordmark. Emerald teal, fresh & modern.

white.$description: Varian monokrom terang (di atas latar gelap).

wordmark.$description: Teks di-outline ke path (opentype.js) — SVG final tidak butuh font terpasang.

tagline.$description: sizeRatio = ukuran tagline terhadap em wordmark.

geometry.$description: Rasio turunan dari pengukuran 3 gambar referensi (dihitung di brand/scripts/build.mjs).

horizontal.$comment: em = emRatio × iconH; baseline/taglineBaseline = ratio × iconH (baseline dari atas ikon).

stacked.$comment: capTop = 1.06 × iconH (jarak ikon→top kapital wordmark); tagline offset dalam satuan em wordmark.

size.clearSpace: ≥ 0.5 × tinggi ikon di keempat sisi lockup
